summary.text: Lisa Cole is a Republican member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 4 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is an attorney and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Cole was born in Johnstown, Pennsylvania, and earned a high school diploma from Somerset Area High School, a bachelor's degree from Allegheny College in 1996, and a law degree from the Mitchell Hamline School of Law in 2023.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she started her first small business in 2010, focusing on land and utility development, and passed the Nevada bar exam in 2023.
She assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Richard McArthur.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Commerce and Labor, Judiciary, and Legislative Operations and Elections committees.
Her Democratic opponent in the 2026 general election is Eileen Eady.
